title: Beta
shortDescription: Build Swiggy Instamart carts by voice or text, with smart address suggestions.
fullDescription:
Beta helps testers build grocery carts in Swiggy Instamart and Blinkit using voice or text. Swiggy Instamart is first and uses Beta's direct MCP connection for a faster, more reliable experience. Google text-to-speech reads key confirmations aloud in Indian English when available. Blinkit remains available and is clearly labelled as beta in the app.

For Swiggy Instamart, Beta shows your saved delivery addresses, recent choices and live product options. With optional location permission, Beta reverse-geocodes the current device location on the phone and uses the result only to rank nearby saved addresses. Raw GPS coordinates are not sent to Beta's cloud or stored by Beta. Recent Swiggy delivery history and recent in-app selections also help rank likely addresses first. You still choose and confirm the saved address, and Beta reads a shortened address confirmation aloud.

Beta then searches the address-specific Instamart catalogue, uses recent product choices to rank live results, shows every proposed cart change and asks for final confirmation before adding anything. Longer grocery lists are processed in small reliable batches while keeping one final cart review. A reversible screen-assisted Swiggy fallback remains available.

For direct Swiggy use, Beta processes a pseudonymous installation identity, an encrypted Swiggy connection token, saved address details, address-specific catalogue results and availability, recent-order product history, the current cart and the saved address you confirm. Beta does not see the Swiggy OTP, store raw voice audio, use GPS as the authoritative delivery selector, place orders, make payments or complete checkout.

For Blinkit and the optional Swiggy screen-assisted fallback, Beta uses Android AccessibilityService and screen capture only after the user starts a cart-building flow and accepts the prominent disclosure. It may read visible product names, prices, cart contents, buttons and delivery details only to build the requested cart. Direct Swiggy MCP use does not use AccessibilityService or screen capture.

Beta always stops before checkout and payment. You review the cart and pay in the grocery app yourself. Beta does not sell personal data or use it for advertising.
